label: SECONDARY POST-BENCHMARK DIAGNOSTIC -- tests batch-composition/batch-size invariance of Loghi inference; does not modify GT, official predictions, or crops
scope: narrowly scoped to the primary question: does Loghi produce the same prediction for a fixed input image regardless of batch size, ordering, or companion geometry

test_set.selection_rule: 4 mandatory changed-but-byte-identical lines (from the loghi-minwidth-padding-v1 unchanged-lines check) + 20 narrow empty-output lines (width<100px, seed 20260927 sample of 42) + 20 narrow non-empty lines (width<100px, same seed, sample of 122) + 39 normal-width controls (width 600-850px, same seed, sample of full pool) + 17 very-wide lines (width>850px, entire population -- only 17 exist). Frozen before any batch-condition inference was run.

model_identity: loghi-swedish-scratch-exp2-epoch7 (same pinned checkpoint/container/beam width/seed as the official run)
note: Stopping rule condition A (reproducible batch-composition/batch-size effect) was met after this matrix; no further conditions were run, per the task's explicit hard limits.
unaltered_inputs: all conditions read directly from the frozen official benchmark crops (benchmark-data/benchmark/svea-hovratt-2026-09-primary-v2); no new image transformation was created; GT and official predictions were never modified.
